lines.say: Stop typing your whole shop name into your AI poster prompt.
lines.show: Stop typing your full shop name.

lines.say: Look at his poster. The name is spelled wrong.
Here's why. Many AI image tools start from noise and clean it up, step by step.
lines.show: Many tools clean up noise, step by step.

lines.say: It's like a blurry photo coming into focus. Big things get clear first.
lines.show: Like a blurry photo coming into focus.

lines.say: Tiny letters stay fuzzy. It doesn't read them. It sees shapes, not spelling.
Here's the fix. One to three words, in quotes. Or just add text in Canva.
lines.show: 1 to 3 words. In quotes. Or Canva.

lines.say: Now the name is spelled right. Fixed.
Here's the catch. Newer models do better. Still, check every letter, phone numbers most.
lines.show: The catch: check every letter, phone numbers most.

lines.say: Send this to the shop owner friend who printed a poster with a typo.
lines.show: Send this to your shop owner friend.

lines.say: Comment CRAFT and I'll send you the prompt.
